name: page_edit
description: Create or edit one text file within a static-page workspace. The relative path is jailed to that page; do not use this for binary assets. Use replace only when old_string exactly identifies the intended text.

path.description: Relative text-file path inside the page, for example index.html or assets/icon.svg.

content.description: New file content, appended content, or replacement text depending on mode.

old_string.description: Required only for replace mode; the exact first occurrence is replaced.
